label: Wavefront labels
subgoals: Give every unlabelled free neighbour of label k the label k + 1
Read a cell's label as its distance around blockages

label: Reaching the target and retracing
subgoals: Stop when the target receives a label
Retrace from the target through labels decreasing by one
Prefer the same direction during retrace to reduce bends

label: The cost of the wavefront
subgoals: Count the cells with label exactly k as wavefront k
Estimate about 2D squared cells explored for a target at distance D
Bound or guide the search to cut wasted expansion
